body.prompt: Instrumental percussion only, 60 BPM, 4/4. A soft, steady, suspenseful pulse for a secret vote at night: a quiet rim click on beats two and four, a soft shaker in eighth notes, a gentle brush swirl. No pitched instruments, no melody, no chords, no bass, no fills, no build-up, no ending, the same throughout so it can loop seamlessly.

headers.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: POST, PATCH, OPTIONS, DELETE, GET, PUT
